TOC_MARKER = "\0toc\0" Block = Struct.new(:kind, :text, :number, :children, :items, :alignments, :rows, :lines, :ordered, keyword_init: true) TocEntry = Struct.new(:level, :id, :label, :children) def escape_html(text) text.gsub(/[&<>"]/, '&' => '&', '<' => '<', '>' => '>', '"' => '"') end def strip_tags(text) = text.gsub(/<[^>]*>/, '') def atx_heading(line) match = /\A(\#{1,6})(?: |\z)/.match(line) return nil unless match text = line[match[1].size..].strip trimmed = text.sub(/\#+\z/, '') text = trimmed.strip if trimmed.empty? || trimmed.end_with?(' ') Block.new(kind: :heading, text: text, number: match[1].size) end class BlockParser def parse(lines) blocks = [] at = 0 while at < lines.size line = lines[at] if line.empty? at += 1 next end if (heading = atx_heading(line)) blocks << heading at += 1 next end if line.start_with?('>') content = [] while at < lines.size && lines[at].start_with?('>') content << lines[at][1..].delete_prefix(' ') at += 1 end alert = /\A\[!(NOTE|TIP|IMPORTANT|WARNING|CAUTION)\]\z/.match(content.first) content.shift if alert blocks << Block.new(kind: alert ? :alert : :quote, text: alert&.[](1), children: parse(content)) next end text = [line.lstrip] at += 1 level = nil while at < lines.size && !lines[at].empty? text = text.join("\n") blocks << Block.new(kind: level ? :heading : (text == '[TOC]' ? :toc : :paragraph), text: text, number: level) end blocks def emphasis(pieces, first = 0, finish = pieces.size) html = +'' at = first while at < finish piece = pieces[at] if piece.is_a?(String) html << piece at += 1 end html end class Renderer def initialize(references, footnotes) @used_ids = {} @headings = [] def inline(text, links: true, notes: true) pieces = [] at = 0 while at < text.size char = text[at] if '*_~'.include?(char) else pieces << escape_html(char) at += 1 end end emphasis(pieces) end def document(blocks) html = render_blocks(blocks) contents = table_of_contents html = html.gsub(TOC_MARKER) { contents } html end def render_blocks(blocks) = blocks.map { |block| render(block) + "\n" }.join def render(block) case block.kind when :heading then heading(block.number, block.text) when :quote then "
\n#{render_blocks(block.children)}
" when :toc then TOC_MARKER def heading(level, text) start = text.rindex(' {#') candidate = start && text.end_with?('}') ? text[(start + 3)...-1] : nil if candidate && /\A[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\z/.match?(candidate) id = candidate text = text[...start].sub(/ +\z/, '') else base = text.downcase.gsub(/[^a-z0-9_ \n-]/, '').tr(" \n", '--') base = 'heading' if base.empty? id = base suffix = 1 while @used_ids.key?(id) id = "#{base}-#{suffix}" suffix += 1 end end @used_ids[id] = true html = inline(text) @headings << TocEntry.new(level, id, strip_tags(html), []) %(#{html}) end def toc_list(entries) html = +"
    \n" entries.each do |entry| html << %(
  • #{entry.label}) html << "\n#{toc_list(entry.children)}\n" unless entry.children.empty? html << "
    • \n" end html << '
' end def table_of_contents roots = [] parents = [] @headings.each do |entry| parents.pop while !parents.empty? && parents.last.level >= entry.level (parents.empty? ? roots : parents.last.children) << entry parents << entry end %(
\n#{toc_list(roots)}\n
) end lines = [] STDIN.each_line do |line| line = line.chomp break if line == '@@END@@' lines << line end parser = BlockParser.new blocks = parser.parse(lines) print Renderer.new(parser.references, parser.footnotes).document(blocks)
